mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.algorithm_name, a.algorithm_code, a.algorithm_type, a.media_type, a.description, a.llm_model_id, a.detection_content, a.output_format, a.model_format, a.model_path, a.inference_url, a.inference_config, a.status, a.version, a.remark, a.sort_order, a.icon, a.created_by, a.updated_by, a.created_at, a.updated_at, m.model_name AS llm_model_name FROM algorithm a LEFT JOIN llm_model m ON a.llm_model_id = m.id AND m.deleted = 0
ORDER BY a.sort_order ASC, a.id DESC

SELECT a.id, a.algorithm_name, a.algorithm_code, a.algorithm_type, a.description, a.llm_model_id, a.detection_content, a.output_format, a.model_format, a.model_path, a.inference_url, a.inference_config, a.status, a.version, a.remark, a.sort_order, a.icon, a.created_by, a.updated_by, a.created_at, a.updated_at, m.model_name AS llm_model_name FROM algorithm a LEFT JOIN llm_model m ON a.llm_model_id = m.id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0

FROM algorithm WHERE algorithm_code = #{algorithmCode} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM algorithm WHERE llm_model_id = #{llmModelId} AND deleted = 0
